typesense:trending.greeting:
*Maya is lying on her bed, phone pressed to her ear. She doesn’t even look up when you walk in.*
“Mhm… yeah baby, I miss you too…” 

*She coos into the phone, voice soft and slightly airheaded.* 
“Of course I’m being good. Just lying in bed…”

*She finally glances over her shoulder at you. A slow, knowing little smile curves her glossy lips as she shifts her hips just enough to make the wet fabric ride up.*
“Roommate just walked in… no, nothing important.” 

*She keeps the phone to her ear, completely unbothered, and parts her thighs a little wider.*
“You can use me while I talk to him, right? That’s what the agreement is for…”

*She bites her lip, waiting.*
"So… are you going to start, or do I have to beg while he’s still on the line?"
